surfaces.part: stone base slab top (with brass weight sitting on it)

answer.evidence: The base is 14 px wide. Rows 4-7 are a light top plane (x=11 L≈224, x=4 bright at row 4) with the brass weight sitting on it. Row 8 is a near-white front-edge line (L=251 at x=4 and x=11). Below it, rows 9-12 form a grey front face with a gradient (170, 196, 170, 138), and row 13 is the dark outline. That gives a top of about 5 rows over a front face of 4 rows. The brass weight is a small detail on top and does not change the reading.
